column1: # p0521: phases already over a goal bound when the rule was installed.
# From here a listed phase may only get SHORTER, a new phase may not join, and a phase
# that now fits must LEAVE this list — the test fails either way. Every row is in done/,
# whose CONTENT is not edited. A done phase's file name is a pointer the record carries
# and may be renamed (2026-09-07-4e6a relabelled every one from p0400 upward), which is
# why no slug row remains: a name over the bound is renamed, not baselined.
#   slug         file-name tail over 50 characters (date-minted namespace)
#   schema-goal  goal over the embedded schema's own 2000, which the whole-file check reads
